logline: When ruthless thugs desecrate Juliana's medicinal garden and trample her late mother's herbs, a protective Alexander charges into the night to defend her.
continuity_notes: Follows Episode 14 where Alexander solemnly vowed Juliana would never be hurt again; Juliana's hands remain heavily bandaged from retrieving the emerald ring.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: High-angle wide shot of the raised planter beds illuminated by the pale moonlight as three shadowy figures march purposefully down the central stone path.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Three menacing thugs, armed with clubs and tools, stalk through the quiet herbal garden surrounded by stone walls.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle medium shot focusing on one thug raising a heavy wooden club overhead.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The thug brutally smashes his club down into a wooden planter box, shattering the frame.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: A splintering wooden crash echoing through the night air.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of a bald thug leaning over a lush bed of white medicinal chamomile herbs.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The bald thug roughly rips a massive handful of flowering herbs up by their roots, scattering soil across the path.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot framing the open doorway of the stone cottage, bathed in warm interior light against the dark night.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana bursts through the cottage doorway, her hands wrapped in clean white bandages, freezing in horror at the destruction.

events.label: JULIANA (Desperate, Alarmed)
events.content: "Stop! What are you doing?!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap holding the uprooted chamomile bouquet, sneering with cruel amusement.

events.label: THUG WITH CAP (Mocking, Smug)
events.content: "We're clearing this rubbish."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Juliana, her face tight with anguish and fury as she clutches her bandaged hands against her chest.

events.label: JULIANA (Furious, Pleading)
events.content: "Those are medicinal plants!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle shot tracking down from the bald thug's grinning face to his worn leather boots on the muddy flagstones.

events.label: BALD THUG (Callous)
events.content: "They look like weeds to me."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The bald thug flings the bouquet into the mud and grinds his heavy boot directly onto the delicate flowers.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: High-angle two-shot as Juliana rushes forward and drops directly onto her knees in the cold mud before the thug.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana frantically tries to scoop the crushed soil and torn stems back into the bed with her bandaged hands.

events.label: JULIANA (Choked with Tears, Desperate)
events.content: "Please! Those plants took months to grow!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium two-shot of the Tall Thug with the club and the Thug with Cap bursting into raucous laughter under the full moon.

events.label: TALL THUG (Contemptuous, Derisive)
events.content: "Months? You actually spend your days growing this filth?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands trembling as she tenderly gathers the soiled white flowers from the puddles.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle medium shot tilting up as Juliana rises from the ground, standing tall despite her trembling frame.

events.label: JULIANA (Defiant, Firm)
events.content: "Leave my garden alone."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap scoffing derisively.

events.label: THUG WITH CAP (Sneering, Disdainful)
events.content: "A noble lady playing in the dirt. What a joke."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana, her eyes blazing with indignation and wounded pride.

events.label: JULIANA (Resolute, Dignified)
events.content: "It is my home. You have no right to destroy anything here."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up of the Thug with Cap stepping aggressively into Juliana's personal space, snarling with venom.

events.label: THUG WITH CAP (Menacing Snarl)
events.content: "Get out of the way!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up on Juliana's piercing blue eyes and set jaw, unflinching.

events.label: JULIANA (Steely, Fearless)
events.content: "No."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The Thug with Cap violently shoves Juliana back with both hands; she cries out as she loses her balance and crashes hard onto the wet stone path.

events.label: JULIANA (Gasping Cry)
events.content: "Ah!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up tracking down to Juliana's hand hitting the mud next to the crushed chamomile flowers.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana crawls forward on her elbows; fresh crimson blood seeps profusely through her white gauze bandages as she reaches for the ruined blossoms.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up on Juliana's mud-streaked, tear-stained face trembling in heartbreaking agony.

events.label: JULIANA (Broken, Sobbing)
events.content: "My mother's plants..."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle wide shot of the three thugs pointing and laughing hysterically at her kneeling form.

events.label: BALD THUG (Cruel, Laughing)
events.content: "Look at her! Crying over weeds!"

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The Tall Thug hoists his heavy wooden club above his head to crush the remaining herbs right before Juliana.

events.label: JULIANA (Screaming)
events.content: "Stop!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap suddenly stiffening, his smug smile dropping as footsteps pound in the darkness.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium tracking shot as Alexander charges past the corner of the cottage into the misty moonlight, his dark coat billowing behind him.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander storms forward with lethal intensity, dark hair flying, breath misting in the cold, radiating untamed rage.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana looking up through wet lashes, trembling as shock transforms into overwhelming relief.

events.label: JULIANA (Whispered Breath, Stunned)
events.content: "Alexander..."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot of the three thugs wheeling around to face the dark figure approaching from the mist.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle tracking shot from behind Alexander's broad shoulders as he steadily steps past the fallen Juliana, towering over the intruders.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander places himself directly between Juliana and the three thugs, staring them down with cold, deadly intent.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of the three thugs regrouping, the Thug with Cap feigning swagger as he grips his club.

events.label: THUG WITH CAP (Challenging, Arrogant)
events.content: "What? You want to fight us, veteran?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana looking up with wide, anxious eyes, breath hitching in suspense as violence hangs on a knife's edge.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Tense, low dramatic cello swell holding into an abrupt cliffhanger cut.
